vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Nissan LH/RH = the vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/passenger side, RH = UK offside/driver side). Numbers were read from web-search result titles and extracts of the cited pages; page fetches were blocked in this session (shop.nissan.co.uk could not be opened), and the shared search budget ran out before front wings, door shells, complete mirrors, tailgate, cooling parts, sensors, wheels and glass were researched. The Nissan UK shop marks most of these parts as chassis-number (VIN) specific and mostly gives compatibility as 2021 to 2024 (pre-facelift); the 2024 facelift restyled the front end. Prices are Nissan UK shop prices as indexed by search and may be out of date. Verify every number by VIN.
